description.unrestricted: The instructor places no restrictions on AI use.

disclosure.title: Privacy
disclosure.short: {{product}} keeps your courses on this computer. Your AI app reads them only when you ask.
disclosure.full: When you ask your AI app about a course, it reads that course's materials from {{product}} and sends them to your AI provider under your own account. {{product}} itself stores nothing remotely. You're responsible for following each course's AI policy — and you can turn sharing off for any course.

canvasNotice: Personal access tokens are for your own use only, and they expire — Canvas shows the maximum when you create one (often 30–90 days).
